metadata.name: Homedex
metadata.description: Homedex 0.2.5 is a read-only homelab inventory of services, ports, routes, and certificate expiry.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: HOMEDEX_LISTEN
environment_variables.description: Address and port Homedex listens on inside the container.

environment_variables.name: HOMEDEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Admin password stored as an Argon2id hash on first start. Homedex 0.2.5 exits while this is shorter than 12 characters, so replace CHANGE_ME before the first start. Ignored after an admin exists.

environment_variables.name: CONTAINERS
environment_variables.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker containers.

environment_variables.name: IMAGES
environment_variables.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker images.

environment_variables.name: INFO
environment_variables.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker info.

environment_variables.name: NETWORKS
environment_variables.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker networks.

environment_variables.name: VERSION
environment_variables.description: Allow the socket proxy to read the Docker version.

environment_variables.name: POST
environment_variables.description: Disable mutating Docker API calls on the socket proxy.

environment_variables.name: ALLOW_START
environment_variables.description: Deny container start through the socket proxy.

environment_variables.name: ALLOW_STOP
environment_variables.description: Deny container stop through the socket proxy.

environment_variables.name: ALLOW_RESTARTS
environment_variables.description: Deny container restart through the socket proxy.

volumes.description: Docker socket, read by the filtering proxy only

before_install.en_us: Replace HOMEDEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD before the first start. The shipped value is CHANGE_ME, and Homedex 0.2.5 exits until the password is at least 12 characters. Homedex hashes the replacement on first start and does not replace that hash later. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit the literal; they do not substitute Compose variables. Open http://localhost:7377 and sign in as admin. Add the prefilled Docker source tcp://docker-socket-proxy:2375. That proxy mounts the Docker socket read-only and rejects mutating API calls.
